endpoint: Primary safety/adverse-event assessment and secondary motor and dopamine-production outcomes through 24 months.
model_limitations: Single-centre, investigator-initiated, open-label Phase I/II study without a control group.
Seven participants contributed to safety assessment and six to efficacy assessment.
The cell product and transplant context are specific to this study and cannot stand for other products.
uncertainty: Motor outcomes are secondary in a small uncontrolled study and remain exploratory.
Long-term durability, disease modification, and transferability are not established.
negative_or_conflicting_evidence: The paper reports 73 adverse events: 72 mild and one moderate dyskinesia event; no serious adverse events were reported.
Motor improvement was not uniform across participants, and the design cannot separate treatment effects from placebo or observer effects.
transferability_limits: Does not establish efficacy or clinical readiness for Parkinson disease cell replacement as a class.
Does not establish disease modification or safety for other cell sources, products, doses, or transplantation methods.
conflict_of_interest: Consult the article disclosure; not independently adjudicated in this record.
